snippet.title: PinKeep | Reveal Trailer | A Pinball Deckbuilding Roguelite by Okomotive
snippet.description:
PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

Demo coming January 2026!
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4143700/PinKeep/
https://www.pin-keep.com
